visualCharacteristics.purpose: side-by-side contact or action options, each a button above a short description
visualCharacteristics.layout: 3 equal centered columns on desktop, stacked on mobile; outlined button over short text

contentPattern.structure: one row; each cell: a paragraph with a single link (becomes the button) followed by a description paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for a fixed set of 2-4 parallel calls to action (phone, email, form). For content columns with images use columns.
